verses.1: Hear me, you followers of righteousness, those who seek Jehovah’s will. Look at the abyss of destruction, and at the pit of hell.
verses.2: Look at Abraham, your father, and to Sarah, your mother. For one person called them “father” and blessed them.
verses.3: For Jehovah has comforted Zion; He has repaired all its damages. Its wilderness has been made like a garden of Jehovah’s delight. There, joy and song will be found.
verses.4: Hear me, my people! Listen to me, my nation. For from me will come laws and judgments that will shine in the light of nations.
verses.5: Korov Tzidki Yatsai, Yeshui. And the descendants of the nations will be judged by me. I will judge them, and their descendants will be punished.
verses.6: Lift your eyes to the heavens and look down upon the earth below. You will see that the heavens are like salted dough, while the earth is like a garment torn apart. Its inhabitants will also die. But my righteousness will never be destroyed, and my justice will never fail.
verses.7: Hear me, O people of righteousness! Take my teachings into your hearts. Do not fear human shame or their insults. Do not be deceived by them.
verses.8: For as rags they will eat each other; as rottenness, they will be consumed. But my righteousness will always remain, and my salvation will last forever.
verses.9: Oh, how bitter is the heart of those who serve Jehovah! Oh, how painful are the days of ancient times! You are the one who causes suffering and pain.
verses.10: Oh, you are indeed the one who will bring destruction upon the sea from east to west. It will be a difficult journey to cross through those deep waters.
verses.11: And the blessings of Jehovah will return; Zion will come back in joy and happiness. They will be filled with eternal gladness upon their heads. They will enjoy peace and joy.
verses.12: I, I am who will comfort you from the fear of those who die. From the time a man is born until he dies, he will be given something in return.
verses.13: And Jehovah forgot about your creations. He abandoned them in the wilderness, and they became weak and helpless. They were always afraid of the threats of those who wanted to destroy them. What kind of threats are those?
verses.14: Hurry up and open it! Don’t delay any longer. There’s no need to wait any longer.
verses.15: And I, Jehovah your God, will control the waves of the sea. Then Jehovah’s army will be victorious.
verses.16: And I will bring my words before you, and through the shadow of my hands, I will plant them in the heavens and on the earth. And I will say to Zion, “You are my people.”
verses.17: Arise, arise! Come to Jerusalem, where the Lord has poured out His wrath upon it. The ark of God has been destroyed; the ark of the covenant has been broken.
verses.18: She has no ruler over any of her children. She also has no one who can hold her hand during her childhood.
verses.19: Two things have befallen you today. Who will rescue you from the lion, the wild animal, hunger, and destruction? Who will comfort you?
verses.20: Your children have fallen asleep, with their heads covered in all their garments. They are like those who are filled with the wrath of God. It’s the anger of your God!
verses.21: Therefore, listen to this: it is a lamentation and a sorrowful cry, and not from me.
verses.22: As Adonai says, “Oh LORD my God! Now, I have taken away from you the cup of suffering. You must not let me drink it again.”
verses.23: And she was placed in the hands of a magician, who said to your soul, “Live and be carried along.” Then she was placed on the ground, like a wilderness for travelers.
